Brief Data.proposition: At the heart of the Sydney Swans for 40 years

task.main: Evolve the existing 40 year anniversary campaign to support the Sydney Swans finals series while keeping the 40 year partnership front and centre.
goals: Reinforce QBE's 40 year partnership with the Sydney Swans
Demonstrate ongoing support of the team regardless of game results
Refresh existing creative platform while maintaining the strong 40 year/40 icon presence
Acknowledge the Swans finals campaign without assuming Grand Final qualification
Develop contingency creative for Grand Final win and loss scenarios
Create potential AFLW season teaser asset for upcoming SCG opener

deliverables.main: 3-4 evolved campaign concepts across OOH, digital, and social with contingency and AFLW assets

items: Digital format example for first presentation
Social posts for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn
Contingency creative for Grand Final win scenario
Contingency creative for Grand Final loss scenario
Potential AFLW season teaser asset (e.g. 'Bring on 2026 for the girls')

budget_range.notes: Budget is under pressure and campaign could be cancelled if not approved; media spend may be sourced from brand budget pending Yazzie's confirmation.

requirements: AFL approval required with minimum 2 weeks turnaround
Must use the 40 year lockup created by the agency
40 year partnership must remain the lead story throughout all creative
ASA player rules apply - single ASA player permitted in game-day imagery; non-ASA players require 5+ players in shot
Must avoid language that assumes or predicts Grand Final qualification
Must comply with all QBE brand guidelines
DV360 standard sizes required for digital assets
Images sourced from aflphoto.com; Swans to provide ASA player list and key moments
Prefer normal home Guernsey imagery over Indigenous or Pride guernseys
Cannot use big screen at stadium during finals - LED buy required
Creative is an evolution (image/copy swap-outs), not a full reconception
Digital display assets to be dispatched directly to Costo (Matt)

timeline_overview.description: Budget confirmation meeting with Cath; Yazzie to confirm brand budget allocation.
First round to show images and headlines including one animated OOH, one static OOH, one static social post, and digital format example.

timeline_overview.phase: Creative Due to AFL/Swans for Approval
timeline_overview.description: Creative must be submitted to AFL approval platform by 6th August to allow minimum 2-week approval window.
Minimum 2-week AFL approval turnaround; particularly lengthy during finals period.
Campaign launches across OOH and digital channels on 20th August.
Potential home final week commencing 31st August (first or second weekend of September).
Campaign runs end of August through to potentially end of September if Swans reach the Grand Final.

references.heading: Existing 40 Year Anniversary Campaign
references.description: Created earlier in the season for opening round; has been running throughout the season and is performing well. Explored executions with smaller/bigger 40 device, different shapes, and players popping out of the device.

references.heading: AFL Approval Platform
references.description: All creative must be submitted through the official AFL approval platform with a minimum 2-week turnaround required.

references.heading: aflphoto.com
references.description: Primary source for player imagery; Swans to provide list of ASA players and key moments with image numbers.

references.heading: Subiaco Lions Contingency Precedent
references.description: Agency previously completed similar win/lose contingency creative work for Subiaco Lions, serving as a reference model.

references.heading: Success Metrics
references.description: Swans end-of-year fan survey results; same KPIs as the original 40 year anniversary campaign (this is an extension).
